notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures, one of which must be an artifact creature.
easyPrerequisites: "Legion" chosen with Battle of Hoover Dam.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Battle of Hoover Dam triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
